title: Docs stdlib resolution for release installs

features.description: Expose loader-owned stdlib root resolution and replace the private docs candidate list.
acceptance_criteria: Docs and compiler filesystem lookup use the same candidate builder
Tests pin override, development, binary-relative, user-data, and system precedence
Terminal errors contain the attempted roots and override remedy

features.description: Read every stdlib docs mode through an fs.FS abstraction with existing std.FS as the final fallback.
acceptance_criteria: List, module, examples, and all-functions modes work with embedded sources only
Filesystem sources retain precedence over embedded sources
Genuine absence remains a traced non-zero failure

features.description: Package bin plus full stdlib sources and smoke-test extracted archives without repository state.
acceptance_criteria: Unix and Windows archives contain bin, all stdlib sources, and std/VERSION
Extracted docs --list succeeds with no override
Extracted compiler smoke test resolves a stdlib import
Release validation fails when stdlib contents are missing

execution_gate: User must approve this plan and explicitly say execute sprint
